items.summary: Implement Motoko backend support for caller user profiles by adding public shared methods `getCallerUserProfile()` and `saveCallerUserProfile(...)` in `backend/main.mo`, storing profiles in the existing `userProfiles` map keyed by caller Principal, and returning the created/updated profile.

Wire the frontend React Query hooks to the real backend profile methods: update `useGetCallerUserProfile` and `useSaveCallerUserProfile` in `frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts` to call the backend methods, keep the existing query key `['currentUserProfile']`, and ensure the query is invalidated/refetched on successful save so the Profile Setup dialog is dismissed by `App.tsx` logic.
